first_kill_hint: Butchering a creature, the colonists found a prison tag under its skin. The number looks familiar - they issue those here.

texts.breakdown: The raid brings a malfunction: {target} goes down.
texts.sick: In the chaos {target} caught a fever.
texts.cave_in: A tremor accompanies the creatures: part of the deposit is buried under rubble.

branches.text: The inspector recounted the essence, winced, and issued rations "for exemplary upkeep". The cameras recorded everything, of course.
The inspection found a shortfall in the stockpile. A fine, sanctions and a very polite threat.

rumors_fade.text: The escape rumors died down: the "way out" turned out to be a hatch into the trash compactor.

choice.text: Smugglers offer provisions and parts for 5 refined essence. The guards don't like that sort of thing.

yes.text: Deal done. The cargo was dropped near the pod; the wardens suspect something.
yes.fail_text: The smugglers came for essence and found an empty stockpile. They left offended.

no.text: You stayed silent on the air. The smugglers took no offense; the wardens learned nothing.

branches.text: Amnesty decree: one prisoner's debt is cut "on humanitarian grounds".
Decree: quotas raised by a quarter. The Metropole reminds you that labor sets you free.
